svg.title: github-stars, a real run on Windows 11, 14 Nov 2026
svg.desc: Terminal, a real run: node tools/trackers/github-stars/github-stars.mjs --user antirez --state stars.json; node tools/trackers/github-stars/github-stars.mjs --user antirez --state stars.json. Notes: The first run saves the list: 100 stars go into stars.json. Nothing is announced, because nothing is new yet. "pushed" counts alerts sent, through ntfy (a free service that notifies a phone) or a webhook. Every later run is a comparison: Plain code compares GitHub's list with the saved one. Run by an agent, the answer is this line: 72 tokens in the measured run. Run on a timer with no agent, a check that finds nothing costs none, and your agent is told only when a star is new.
